headline: Peticiones para nuevas aceras en Clover St. y Heard St., nombres honorarios de calles, una barrera de seguridad, faroles, reparaciones de aceras y repavimentación de calles.

review: items 9: 'held' is translated as 'mantenida', which suggests the petition was kept or maintained rather than held over from a prior meeting. It should say it was held over (e.g., 'pospuesta' or 'dejada pendiente').; items 12: 'held three times in 2026' is translated 'mantenida tres veces', which does not convey that the petition was held over at meetings. It is misleading.; summary: 'Several petitions were held at earlier meetings' is translated 'se mantuvieron en reuniones anteriores', which does not convey that they were held over/postponed; it reads as 'were kept'. This misleads.; items 31: 'Street resurfacing on Epworth St.' is translated as 'Repavimentación de calles en Epworth St.' (plural 'streets'); it is a single street, so it should be 'de la calle'.
